verdict.rationale: The aihero.dev docs say users can "Install the ones you want" and "Pick the skills and agents you use." A real end-to-end probe confirmed that `--skill tdd` installed only the single tdd skill into ./.claude/skills/tdd/. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the per-skill selection flag (the plugin marketplace routes install the whole set as one bundle).

support.subject: As a developer, I can install only the specific skills I want from a collection instead of taking the whole bundle

citations.quote: Install the ones you want, then type a slash command.
Pick the skills and agents you use. The installer writes editable files into your project.
selectively installed the single `tdd` skill to ./.claude/skills/tdd/
